data.name: Sahu
data.gender_notes: Sahu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the ruler, the owner, the master, the lord, or the protector. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah' which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'. The name Sahu carries the meaning “Lord, Master, Owner” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master, owner and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine within, the inner guru, the higher self, and the absolute truth.
data.etymology: Sahu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master, Owner.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sahu holds significant cultural importance in the Hindu community, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sah', which means 'higher self, the absolute truth'. Individuals bearing this name are often seen as authorities, leaders, and protectors due to its connection to the idea of being above the mundane and having a greater understanding of truth and reality. Within Indian society, the name Sahu has been associated with respect, power, and status.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Sahu carries the connotation of being connected to one's higher self and the absolute truth. It represents an individual's journey towards enlightenment and self-realization, as well as a deep understanding and protection of the spiritual principles that govern the universe. As the name originated from the Sanskrit word 'Sah', which also means 'union', it signifies the ultimate goal of spiritual practice - union with the divine. thus, Sahu is a profound and spiritual name that embodies the aspirations and beliefs of many within the Hindu tradition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sahu, meaning 'master' or 'lord', is a Hindu name symbolizing the inner ruler and guide of one's own self. It is a reminder of the ultimate control each individual holds over their thoughts, actions, and emotions, and the spiritual responsibility to wield this power wisely.

name_in_real_life.story: Lakshmi Sahu from Hyderabad, India embodies the meaning of Sahu - "Lord, Master, Owner". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
